'''Lial Sompa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] and the [[Chief Neurologist]] at the [[Aurora Medical Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. It was there were Sompa and a team of doctors and [[Medical droid/Legends|Medical droids]] successfully kept [[Tobb Jadak]] alive after his accident in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] space.
